title: Abdul-El Sayed, a Democrat, Has an Unlikely Defender: Tucker Carlson
summary: Mr. Carlson, the far-right podcaster, has promoted Dr. El-Sayed’s comments and sharply criticized his Republican rival in a key Senate race. Strategists are scratching their heads.
